files.name: Nib
files.text: Stand still, friend. You're worth two hundred either way.
files.spokenText: Stand still, friend. You're worth two hundred either way.

files.name: Merle
files.text: Let's finish before Delphine comes outside.
files.spokenText: Let's finish before Delphine comes outside.

files.name: Lurleen
files.text: You kept me waiting, sugar. Hold still a moment.
files.spokenText: You kept me waiting, sugar. Hold still a moment.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: You took his coin! Now get past me!
files.spokenText: You took his coin! Now get past me!

files.name: Grukhar
files.text: Unpaid since spring. Now you want my letters too?
files.spokenText: Unpaid since spring. Now you want my letters too?

files.name: Femi
files.text: Keep your hands off me! These papers are mine!
files.spokenText: Keep your hands off me! These papers are mine!

files.name: Gorruk
files.text: In my own tent. You've got nerve, foundling.
files.spokenText: In my own tent. You've got nerve, foundling.

files.name: Mzee Kamau
files.text: Nine graves since that mine opened. Leave this grove.
files.spokenText: Nine graves since that mine opened. Leave this grove.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: You heard us. Stay out of the grove.
files.spokenText: You heard us. Stay out of the grove.

files.name: Olamide
files.text: Those ledgers stay here. So do you.
files.spokenText: Those ledgers stay here. So do you.

files.name: Adigun Adeyinka
files.text: Wait! Killing us won't stop my foster-son!
files.spokenText: Wait! Killing us won't stop my foster-son!

files.name: Bankole
files.text: Guards! Get them away from the records!
files.spokenText: Guards! Get them away from the records!

files.name: Idris
files.text: The Duke needs his rest. I can arrange yours.
files.spokenText: The Duke needs his rest. I can arrange yours.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Lower your sword. Don't make me stop you here.
files.spokenText: Lower your sword. Don't make me stop you here.

files.name: Rasheed
files.text: A bounty AND an invitation. What a generous evening.
files.spokenText: A bounty AND an invitation. What a generous evening.

files.name: Kemi
files.text: The invitations are worth more than you. Move, Rasheed.
files.spokenText: The invitations are worth more than you. Move, Rasheed.

files.name: Jelani
files.text: Cultists! Light the street. Leave the ward to me.
files.spokenText: Cultists! Light the street. Leave the ward to me.

files.name: Segun Marr
files.text: I signed your poster. This saves us a search.
files.spokenText: I signed your poster. This saves us a search.

files.name: Kolade Adeyinka
files.text: Come closer, brother. You've kept me waiting long enough.
files.spokenText: Come closer, brother. You've kept me waiting long enough.

files.name: Gbenga
files.text: Hold still. Your brother wants this done before breakfast.
files.spokenText: Hold still. Your brother wants this done before breakfast.

files.name: Gorruk
files.text: You again! No city to run to this time, foundling.
files.spokenText: You again! No city to run to this time, foundling.

files.name: Amara
files.text: I asked for his life. I haven't changed my mind.
files.spokenText: I asked for his life. I haven't changed my mind.

files.name: Kolade Adeyinka
files.text: Still standing, brother? Then come and finish it.
files.spokenText: Still standing, brother? Then come and finish it.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: That wolf is watching us. The others are watching him.
files.spokenText: That wolf is watching us. The others are watching him.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: His axe has teeth too. Keep away from the edge.
files.spokenText: His axe has teeth too. Keep away from the edge.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: He is small. That staff is not.
files.spokenText: He is small. That staff is not.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: Those bundles in her web are moving.
files.spokenText: Those bundles in her web are moving.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: That is the mother. We are beneath her nest.
files.spokenText: That is the mother. We are beneath her nest.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: He has a staff. Please tell me it is just a stick.
files.spokenText: He has a staff. Please tell me it is just a stick.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: Do not touch the water around her feet.
files.spokenText: Do not touch the water around her feet.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: He has already broken that shield. Look at his shoulder.
files.spokenText: He has already broken that shield. Look at his shoulder.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: Three heads. I was rather hoping the third was a tail.
files.spokenText: Three heads. I was rather hoping the third was a tail.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: That hammer has broken armour before. Look at the dents.
files.spokenText: That hammer has broken armour before. Look at the dents.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: That howl means he calling the whole family.
files.spokenText: That howl means he calling the whole family.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: That one laughs before he bites. Charming.
files.spokenText: That one laughs before he bites. Charming.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: Big crown, small fellow. Mind that staff, though.
files.spokenText: Big crown, small fellow. Mind that staff, though.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: Nobody touch that silk. I mean nobody.
files.spokenText: Nobody touch that silk. I mean nobody.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: Look up! Mother has come home angry.
files.spokenText: Look up! Mother has come home angry.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: That staff shining. This one knows more than smashing.
files.spokenText: That staff shining. This one knows more than smashing.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: No bargain with her. Keep your hands to yourself.
files.spokenText: No bargain with her. Keep your hands to yourself.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: That axe can split a door. Don't stand square.
files.spokenText: That axe can split a door. Don't stand square.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: Three mouths? Feeding him must cost a fortune.
files.spokenText: Three mouths? Feeding him must cost a fortune.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: Heavy hammer. Let him swing before you step in.
files.spokenText: Heavy hammer. Let him swing before you step in.

files.name: Winston
files.text: That's a very large argument for taking another road.
files.spokenText: That's a very large argument for taking another road.

files.name: Winston
files.text: I could've charged more for this road.
files.spokenText: I could've charged more for this road.

files.name: Winston
files.text: Lovely crown. Shame about the angry owner.
files.spokenText: Lovely crown. Shame about the angry owner.

files.name: Winston
files.text: Eight legs. Not one decent pocket.
files.spokenText: Eight legs. Not one decent pocket.

files.name: Winston
files.text: We are definitely not getting paid by the wing.
files.spokenText: We are definitely not getting paid by the wing.

files.name: Winston
files.text: He lives under the docks? Rent must be excellent.
files.spokenText: He lives under the docks? Rent must be excellent.

files.name: Winston
files.text: If she offers a discount, run.
files.spokenText: If she offers a discount, run.

files.name: Winston
files.text: Please let that axe be decorative. Ah. No.
files.spokenText: Please let that axe be decorative. Ah. No.

files.name: Winston
files.text: I'm counting three heads and exactly one bad idea.
files.spokenText: I'm counting three heads and exactly one bad idea.

files.name: Winston
files.text: Someone gave him a hammer bigger than my rent.
files.spokenText: Someone gave him a hammer bigger than my rent.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: Stay close. I'll keep those jaws off your flank.
files.spokenText: Stay close. I'll keep those jaws off your flank.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: That laugh carries. His pack will hear it.
files.spokenText: That laugh carries. His pack will hear it.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: Leave him room to surrender. Watch the staff.
files.spokenText: Leave him room to surrender. Watch the staff.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: Cut the hanging bundles down when she's beaten.
files.spokenText: Cut the hanging bundles down when she's beaten.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: Shields over your heads. I'll watch her claws.
files.spokenText: Shields over your heads. I'll watch her claws.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: The crystal's lit. Don't let him point it at you.
files.spokenText: The crystal's lit. Don't let him point it at you.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: Keep clear of her hands. I'll take the staff side.
files.spokenText: Keep clear of her hands. I'll take the staff side.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: He wants us frightened. Set your feet.
files.spokenText: He wants us frightened. Set your feet.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: I'll draw the left head. Watch the other two.
files.spokenText: I'll draw the left head. Watch the other two.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: Keep clear of that hammer. I'll keep him facing me.
files.spokenText: Keep clear of that hammer. I'll keep him facing me.

files.name: Beau
files.text: Th-that's the biggest wolf I've ever seen.
files.spokenText: Th-that's the biggest wolf I've ever seen.

files.name: Beau
files.text: I d-don't think he's laughing with us.
files.spokenText: I d-don't think he's laughing with us.

files.name: Beau
files.text: I can take the staff. I think. Y-yes.
files.spokenText: I can take the staff. I think. Y-yes.

files.name: Beau
files.text: D-don't look up. No, do look up!
files.spokenText: D-don't look up. No, do look up!

files.name: Beau
files.text: Th-those wings could carry a horse.
files.spokenText: Th-those wings could carry a horse.

files.name: Beau
files.text: He's b-bigger than the tunnel. How'd he get in?
files.spokenText: He's b-bigger than the tunnel. How'd he get in?

files.name: Beau
files.text: I d-don't like the way she knows we're here.
files.spokenText: I d-don't like the way she knows we're here.

files.name: Beau
files.text: R-right. Big axe. Bigger shield. Mine, I mean.
files.spokenText: R-right. Big axe. Bigger shield. Mine, I mean.

files.name: Beau
files.text: One, two... th-three. Of course there's three.
files.spokenText: One, two... th-three. Of course there's three.

files.name: Beau
files.text: Th-that hammer. Don't try to catch it on your blade.
files.spokenText: Th-that hammer. Don't try to catch it on your blade.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: Hold the line. Let the pack come to us.
files.spokenText: Hold the line. Let the pack come to us.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: Watch the backstroke. That axe reaches farther than his arms.
files.spokenText: Watch the backstroke. That axe reaches farther than his arms.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: A chief with a staff. Expect the others to rush.
files.spokenText: A chief with a staff. Expect the others to rush.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: Keep clear of the silk. Cut anyone loose immediately.
files.spokenText: Keep clear of the silk. Cut anyone loose immediately.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: She's guarding the cliff. Watch the shadow above you.
files.spokenText: She's guarding the cliff. Watch the shadow above you.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: A spellcaster in a narrow drain. Spread out.
files.spokenText: A spellcaster in a narrow drain. Spread out.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: Keep your boots out of that green water.
files.spokenText: Keep your boots out of that green water.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: He leads with his shoulder. Watch the axe behind it.
files.spokenText: He leads with his shoulder. Watch the axe behind it.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: Don't bunch up. Those heads cover different angles.
files.spokenText: Don't bunch up. Those heads cover different angles.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: He plants before he swings. Move when that foot stops.
files.spokenText: He plants before he swings. Move when that foot stops.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: The pack has gone quiet. He's the one to watch.
files.spokenText: The pack has gone quiet. He's the one to watch.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: He favours the right leg. Keep him turning.
files.spokenText: He favours the right leg. Keep him turning.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: I'll watch his hands. You watch the staff.
files.spokenText: I'll watch his hands. You watch the staff.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: I have the strand. Wait until her feet touch.
files.spokenText: I have the strand. Wait until her feet touch.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: Wait for the wings to open. That's my shot.
files.spokenText: Wait for the wings to open. That's my shot.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: I can see the crystal from here. Keep him facing you.
files.spokenText: I can see the crystal from here. Keep him facing you.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: Her sleeve hides the free hand. Watch it.
files.spokenText: Her sleeve hides the free hand. Watch it.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: There's a gap under his raised arm.
files.spokenText: There's a gap under his raised arm.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: The outer heads turn first. I have the right.
files.spokenText: The outer heads turn first. I have the right.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: The hammer leaves his shoulder open. I can reach that.
files.spokenText: The hammer leaves his shoulder open. I can reach that.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: Vallahi! That is a wolf worth singing about!
files.spokenText: Vallahi! That is a wolf worth singing about!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: He laughs? GOOD! Let us give him something to remember!
files.spokenText: He laughs? GOOD! Let us give him something to remember!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: Little king! Put down that great stick!
files.spokenText: Little king! Put down that great stick!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: Eight legs, Fındık! We shall count them afterward!
files.spokenText: Eight legs, Findik! We shall count them afterward!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: HA! Mother comes to scold us herself!
files.spokenText: HA! Mother comes to scold us herself!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: Big fellow! Come where I can see both your hands!
files.spokenText: Big fellow! Come where I can see both your hands!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: No witch is touching my friends. Back, old woman!
files.spokenText: No witch is touching my friends. Back, old woman!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: A fine axe! Show me if you can lift it!
files.spokenText: A fine axe! Show me if you can lift it!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: Three heads! At last, one to hear EACH warning!
files.spokenText: Three heads! At last, one to hear EACH warning!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: HA! A proper hammer! Come, let us hear it ring!
files.spokenText: HA! A proper hammer! Come, let us hear it ring!

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: Do not answer that howl. Let him wonder.
files.spokenText: Do not answer that howl. Let him wonder.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: Hear how the pack waits for his laugh to end.
files.spokenText: Hear how the pack waits for his laugh to end.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: That staff has been used often. See the scorched grip.
files.spokenText: That staff has been used often. See the scorched grip.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: Do not brush the silk from your coat with bare hands.
files.spokenText: Do not brush the silk from your coat with bare hands.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: She has young nearby. That makes her more dangerous.
files.spokenText: She has young nearby. That makes her more dangerous.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: That blue stone is awake. Stay away from its light.
files.spokenText: That blue stone is awake. Stay away from its light.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: There is sickness in her hands. Do not let her touch you.
files.spokenText: There is sickness in her hands. Do not let her touch you.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: His fury is loud. Watch the quieter hand.
files.spokenText: His fury is loud. Watch the quieter hand.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: One body tires. Three heads do not change that.
files.spokenText: One body tires. Three heads do not change that.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: Watch his grip. He is waiting for you to come closer.
files.spokenText: Watch his grip. He is waiting for you to come closer.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: A large throat. Keep clear while I find my aim.
files.spokenText: A large throat. Keep clear while I find my aim.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: Mind the fur. Fire travels quickly through it.
files.spokenText: Mind the fur. Fire travels quickly through it.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: That crystal has a fracture. I can work with that.
files.spokenText: That crystal has a fracture. I can work with that.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: Keep the silk off me. I will clear a path.
files.spokenText: Keep the silk off me. I will clear a path.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: Do not crowd me. I need room to cast upward.
files.spokenText: Do not crowd me. I need room to cast upward.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: A cave and an angry mage. Mind the ceiling.
files.spokenText: A cave and an angry mage. Mind the ceiling.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: Do not inhale that vapour. Cover your mouths.
files.spokenText: Do not inhale that vapour. Cover your mouths.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: Draw his axe aside. Leave me a clear line.
files.spokenText: Draw his axe aside. Leave me a clear line.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: Keep the heads apart. I need a clear centre.
files.spokenText: Keep the heads apart. I need a clear centre.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: Keep his hammer away from me. I need both hands.
files.spokenText: Keep his hammer away from me. I need both hands.

files.name: Layla
files.text: Such a deep voice. Pity about the breath.
files.spokenText: Such a deep voice. Pity about the breath.

files.name: Layla
files.text: That laugh needs work. Preferably from farther away.
files.spokenText: That laugh needs work. Preferably from farther away.

files.name: Layla
files.text: All that ceremony for such a little throne.
files.spokenText: All that ceremony for such a little throne.

files.name: Layla
files.text: Silk everywhere, and not a single flattering drape.
files.spokenText: Silk everywhere, and not a single flattering drape.

files.name: Layla
files.text: She knows how to make an entrance. Mind the talons.
files.spokenText: She knows how to make an entrance. Mind the talons.

files.name: Layla
files.text: Please keep him over there. Especially when he opens his mouth.
files.spokenText: Please keep him over there. Especially when he opens his mouth.

files.name: Layla
files.text: Darling, I wouldn't touch her hand with a borrowed glove.
files.spokenText: Darling, I wouldn't touch her hand with a borrowed glove.

files.name: Layla
files.text: So much muscle. Such an unpromising temper.
files.spokenText: So much muscle. Such an unpromising temper.

files.name: Layla
files.text: Three admirers at once. How inconvenient.
files.spokenText: Three admirers at once. How inconvenient.

files.name: Layla
files.text: Such a heavy entrance. I hope he tires quickly.
files.spokenText: Such a heavy entrance. I hope he tires quickly.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: Nice entrance. Shame he's here to eat us.
files.spokenText: Nice entrance. Shame he's here to eat us.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: I'd laugh too, carrying an axe that size.
files.spokenText: I'd laugh too, carrying an axe that size.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: I like the crown. I'll shoot around it.
files.spokenText: I like the crown. I'll shoot around it.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: I usually prefer admirers with fewer eyes.
files.spokenText: I usually prefer admirers with fewer eyes.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: Great wings. Terrible place to stand beneath them.
files.spokenText: Great wings. Terrible place to stand beneath them.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: He brought a staff. I'll aim for the fingers.
files.spokenText: He brought a staff. I'll aim for the fingers.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: Keep her looking at you. I've got the crooked wrist.
files.spokenText: Keep her looking at you. I've got the crooked wrist.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: I'm not getting within flirting distance of that axe.
files.spokenText: I'm not getting within flirting distance of that axe.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: One arrow each? No, let's start with the loud one.
files.spokenText: One arrow each? No, let's start with the loud one.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: Nice hammer. I'll admire it from back here.
files.spokenText: Nice hammer. I'll admire it from back here.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: He is warning his pack. Give him no opening.
files.spokenText: He is warning his pack. Give him no opening.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: Hear that? The little ones are waiting for his signal.
files.spokenText: Hear that? The little ones are waiting for his signal.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: He stamps that staff like he owns the ground.
files.spokenText: He stamps that staff like he owns the ground.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: She feels the web through her feet. Step lightly.
files.spokenText: She feels the web through her feet. Step lightly.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: She smells us near her nest. Watch the tail.
files.spokenText: She smells us near her nest. Watch the tail.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: He has fouled this water enough. Sawa. Move him.
files.spokenText: He has fouled this water enough. Sawa. Move him.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: The mud is sick around her. Keep your skin clear.
files.spokenText: The mud is sick around her. Keep your skin clear.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: All that iron. I want him away from the trees.
files.spokenText: All that iron. I want him away from the trees.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: Three hungry heads. Watch the body when they turn.
files.spokenText: Three hungry heads. Watch the body when they turn.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: Let the hammer fall. Then move in before he lifts it.
files.spokenText: Let the hammer fall. Then move in before he lifts it.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: That's a whole winter coat with teeth, that is.
files.spokenText: That's a whole winter coat with teeth, that is.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: Heavy axe, thin haft. I know where I'm aiming.
files.spokenText: Heavy axe, thin haft. I know where I'm aiming.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: That staff's taller than he is. Mind the swing.
files.spokenText: That staff's taller than he is. Mind the swing.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: I did not leave a mine to get wrapped in silk.
files.spokenText: I did not leave a mine to get wrapped in silk.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: Lovely. A roof that bites back.
files.spokenText: Lovely. A roof that bites back.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: Look at that staff. Better stone than his manners deserve.
files.spokenText: Look at that staff. Better stone than his manners deserve.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: Keep that muck off your cuts. It'll fester.
files.spokenText: Keep that muck off your cuts. It'll fester.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: Good iron, bad temper. Familiar combination.
files.spokenText: Good iron, bad temper. Familiar combination.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: Three heads and one neck ache waiting to happen.
files.spokenText: Three heads and one neck ache waiting to happen.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: That head needs a new haft. I'll help it along.
files.spokenText: That head needs a new haft. I'll help it along.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Let him come to us. Keep your blade low.
files.spokenText: Let him come to us. Keep your blade low.

files.name: Amara
files.text: The laugh is a distraction. Watch his hands.
files.spokenText: The laugh is a distraction. Watch his hands.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Small reach. Long staff. Do not confuse the two.
files.spokenText: Small reach. Long staff. Do not confuse the two.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Keep your arms free. I'll cut the silk.
files.spokenText: Keep your arms free. I'll cut the silk.

files.name: Amara
files.text: When she lands, move away from the tail.
files.spokenText: When she lands, move away from the tail.

files.name: Amara
files.text: The staff first. I don't want that spell behind us.
files.spokenText: The staff first. I don't want that spell behind us.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Do not let her close her hand around you.
files.spokenText: Do not let her close her hand around you.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Let him commit to the swing. Then step inside.
files.spokenText: Let him commit to the swing. Then step inside.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Make one head turn. The others will have to follow.
files.spokenText: Make one head turn. The others will have to follow.

files.name: Amara
files.text: Give that hammer room. He cannot change its path quickly.
files.spokenText: Give that hammer room. He cannot change its path quickly.
